title: Spyglass: Explore with Confidence
summary: The official launch of Spyglass provides every user with unparalleled tools to navigate complex data, uncover hidden connections, and make informed decisions effortlessly.

title: Enhanced File Management & Display
summary: Take ultimate command of your content with powerful new tools that allow you to seamlessly add, organize, and visually customize how every file appears directly within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Our brand new roadmap page provides a clear overview of recently completed updates, upcoming features, and our future plans, keeping you informed every step of the way.

title: Beautifully Better Checkboxes
summary: Get ready for a seamless experience with our newly designed checkboxes that are easier to click, drag, and perfectly match our modern interface.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Work together seamlessly with improved collaboration features that provide instant clarity on your team's contributions.

title: Effortless Collaboration & Discoverability of Shared Content
summary: We've enhanced how you share and discover content, making collaboration with your network effortless and more insightful than ever before.

title: Global Language Support
summary: We're excited to offer comprehensive international language support, making Noeko more accessible to users around the globe.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: Experience unprecedented control and transparency as Noeko's codebase is now open source, inviting direct community involvement in its evolution.

title: Supercharge Your Constellation View
summary: Effortlessly explore your entire knowledge base and discover key connections with powerful new filters and integrated sharing capabilities in the enhanced Constellation View.

title: Enhanced Search & Custom Knowledge Views
summary: Unlock the full potential of your knowledge base with new advanced filtering, flexible sorting, and the ability to save your perfectly tailored search results as custom, easily accessible collections.

title: Flexible Content Views
summary: Discover a more intuitive way to organize and interact with your interconnected notes through dynamic new display options, making your information easier to navigate and understand.

title: Noeko: Power Your Projects, Your Way
summary: We're launching Noeko with flexible paid plans, including both self-hosting for ultimate control and convenient cloud-hosted options to fit your needs.

title: A Fresh New Look: Enhanced and Expanded Theme Collection
summary: Get ready to personalize your experience with a host of beautifully designed new themes and significant improvements to our existing collection.

title: Refined Time-Based Greetings
summary: Enjoy a consistently accurate and personalized welcome as we enhance our time-based greetings to always reflect your current time of day.

title: Streamlined Tag Management from List Views
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged items by performing actions like unapplying tags and deleting items directly within your list views, saving you valuable time.

title: Unlock More Ways to Capture Knowledge
summary: Seamlessly integrate and interact with a wider array of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text, to centralize your knowledge and unlock deeper insights from all your valuable information.
